title: Titanium RF Grounding Spring Finger
system: Plasma Chamber Liners, Shields & Thermal Hardware
alloyReason: Bead-blasted Grade 2 CP-Ti (UNS R50400) is chosen for Titanium RF Grounding Spring Finger where controlled surface roughness (Ra 3.2-6.3 µm) improves adhesion of applied coatings or bonding agents. The 345 MPa yield with 30% elongation provides sufficient ductility for forming operations while maintaining the excellent corrosion resistance characteristic of CP titanium. This surface preparation is tailored for RF grounding spring contact finger (Nitinol). This rationale is driven by rf grounding spring contact finger (nitinol) and service environment demands.
process: Cleanroom CNC Class 100 for chamber shield geometry
UHP DI water cascade rinse with Class 6g gauge
Particle count MIL-STD-1246 with Class 6g gauge
surfaceTreatment: Electropolishing Ra <0.25um + UHP DI cascade rinse with particle count verification per MIL-STD-1246 Class 1 — tailored for rf grounding spring application
commonFailures: Outgassing H2O CH4 >1% AMU 100 - mitigated by 200C vacuum bake-out 24h to desorb trapped species — critical for rf grounding spring performance

faq.q: What metallic contamination levels are guaranteed for Titanium RF Grounding Spring Finger?
faq.a: Titanium RF Grounding Spring Finger is manufactured to ensure metallic surface contamination below 1×10¹⁰ atoms/cm² for Fe, Cr, Ni, Cu, and Zn per SEMI F108. For rf grounding spring in front-end processes, additional ICP-MS verification is available with detection limits to 1×10⁸ atoms/cm². Double VAR-melted starting stock ensures inclusion-free microstructure.

faq.q: What is the typical lead time for Titanium RF Grounding Spring Finger orders?
faq.a: Standard lead time for Titanium RF Grounding Spring Finger is 15-25 business days depending on quantity and complexity. Rush orders (3-5 working days) are available for prototype evaluation. Sample evaluation (1-5 units) can be expedited to 5-7 business days. Volume pricing is available for production quantities above 100 units.

faq.q: What material certifications are provided with Titanium RF Grounding Spring Finger?
faq.a: Each Titanium RF Grounding Spring Finger shipment includes EN 10204 Type 3.1 mill test certificate with chemical analysis, mechanical properties, and heat identification. Dimensional inspection reports and Certificate of Conformance (CoC) are standard. First Article Inspection Reports (FAIR) per AS9102 are available on request for rf grounding spring.
